old_problem: The historical Pending state asks the owner to invent a unique purpose versus an adjacent content-identical code and treats unknown raw bytes as required. Neither is necessary: approved duplicate-coverage rules require separate identity/evidence, not different semantics, and the Master Procedure already defines standard read-only SDR and Sensor commands. The real technical need is an exact five-member upper-bank front-tachometer map so a broad fan list does not substitute rear, lower or PSU fan records.
disposition_reason: Resolve Engineering Decision Pending and Source Conflict at the Review layer. The approved duplicate rules require Wistron-BMC-00995-V005 and adjacent Wistron-BMC-00996-V005 to retain independent Source Key/Variant, execution evidence and verdict even if their intended coverage is identical; no fabricated semantic distinction or deletion is required. Standard ipmitool `sdr elist` and `sensor list` already implement the source's read-only collection, so unprovided raw bytes are not a prerequisite. Exact fan FRU/rotor mapping, RPM limits and target values remain runtime Project configuration under the user's parameterization rule.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1723, same-row DeepSeek/test-json content, GPT V2, historical V3.1 record, pending/conflict analyses, exact adjacent row 1724 comparison and ED-01 through ED-30 rules were read. The actual next formal queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1724 / Wistron-BMC-00996-V005 / f7131bc24cf8b6e5.

Approved duplicate/coverage rules prohibit merging or discarding repeated tests and require each Source Key/Variant to retain independent verification identity. They do not require an owner to manufacture different intent where Master content is identical.

This row remains a separate checkpoint with its own target binding, evidence hashes, timestamps, Web capture and verdict. Evidence from row 1724 cannot satisfy this row, and this row cannot satisfy row 1724.

The Procedure explicitly supplies stock `ipmitool sdr elist` and `ipmitool sensor list` through IB/OOB. Upstream ipmitool defines these standard read families; no guessed raw bytes are needed for the stated name/description/reading comparison.

`UPPER_FAN1~5_F` is interpreted only through a signed five-row map: upper bank positions 1-5, front rotor/tachometer, physical FRU/entity and canonical SDR/Sensor/Web identity. Broad `grep fan` is discovery only and cannot define scope.

Five independent evidence planes remain mandatory: IB SDR, OOB SDR, IB Sensor, OOB Sensor and actual BMC Web. Exact RPM/status/threshold/freshness acceptance and control-mode/load tolerance are Project bindings under ED-18, not a remaining Engineering Decision.
ED-10/ED-21 preserve real WebUI evidence, ED-19 removes generic log clearing, ED-26 prohibits retrying for matching RPM, and no fan/PWM/curve/threshold/power/BMC/DUT mutation is authorized.

test_case.test_name: UPPER_FAN1~5_F — independent five upper-front tachometer correlation
test_case.purpose: Independently verify this Source Key's five upper-bank front-rotor tachometers across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and the same-target BMC Web page against the signed fan FRU/RPM matrix, without reusing evidence from the identical adjacent testcase.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/firmware and this Source Key/Variant execution identity; separate evidence namespace and verdict from Wistron-BMC-00996-V005
Signed five-row upper-bank fan map covering positions 1-5, physical FRU/entity, front versus rear rotor/tachometer and canonical SDR/Sensor/Web IDs
Approved fan-control mode, thermal/load context, RPM/status/unit/threshold/freshness rules, paired-rotor behavior and timestamp/skew tolerance
Supported secret-safe ipmitool IB/OOB collectors, same-target proof, complete untruncated SDR/Sensor parsers, comparator and immutable evidence destination
Protected TLS-validated BMC Web access and authorized reviewer with page/filter/pagination/refresh context; reviewed private script only if used as an additive path
test_case.test_command: Bind evidence to this Source Key/Variant, verify one target and record fan-control plus thermal/load context. Capture/hash complete IB `ipmitool sdr elist`, OOB `sdr elist`, IB `sensor list` and OOB `sensor list`; capture all five mapped upper-front rows/details from the same BMC Web Sensor page. Normalize FRU/entity/position/rotor/name/description/RPM/unit/status/threshold/freshness and compare to the signed matrix. Use `grep fan` only after complete capture for discovery. Do not require or guess raw bytes; any approved private/raw script is additive and must not replace these five views. Do not reuse row 1724 evidence, clear logs or change fan state.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly five approved upper-bank front tachometers appear once in every applicable plane, map to the correct positions/FRUs/front rotors and agree on name, description, unit, status, thresholds and fresh RPM within the signed control-mode/load/time tolerance. Rear rotors, lower-bank fans and PSU fans are excluded. Evidence is unique to this Source Key/Variant and collection causes no fan, SDR, BMC, power or log mutation.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS evidence requires this row's own complete five-member/five-view comparison against the signed matrix and genuine WebUI captures; command exit zero, a broad fan grep, plausible RPM, one view, guessed raw response or copied adjacent-row evidence is insufficient. Missing/extra/duplicate/stale/misnumbered members, wrong bank/rotor/FRU, unexplained cross-view/RPM/status difference or unapproved tolerance is reported for engineer FAIL/BLOCKED disposition. Runtime values may be bound by the Project; the end user decides the verdict.
safety_gate: Maintain this Source Key/Variant and evidence namespace independently; never merge, copy or substitute evidence/verdict from row 1724.
Do not guess raw IPMI bytes or treat a private script as mandatory unless its reviewed read-only contract is supplied; standard high-level reads are the approved base path.
Keep all operations read-only: do not change fan PWM/mode/curve/threshold, reset fans/BMC, modify SDR, alter workload/power or clear logs.
Verify same-target IB/OOB/Web identity, protect credentials/tokens and reject truncated, cached, cross-host or paginated-away evidence.
Stop on unmapped rotor, target mismatch, stale/missing/divergent data and preserve the first result; do not automatically retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant and independent evidence namespace plus target/firmware/same-target identity
Signed five-position upper-bank FRU/front-tachometer map and fan-control/thermal/load/RPM acceptance matrix
Complete hashed raw IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps and normalized five-member comparison
Timestamped BMC Web captures for all five rows with target/filter/pagination/refresh context
No-evidence-reuse/no-mutation/no-log-clear/no-retry audit, exceptions and engineer-owned PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict
test_case.recovery: Approved operations are reads. On identity, mapping, access, freshness or view mismatch, stop, preserve this row's raw/UI evidence and close sessions; do not alter fan controls, clear logs, reset or retry. If an unintended setting change occurs, invoke only the pre-approved owner procedure for that exact setting and verify the original control mode independently.
